headline: Frontline Bases Shift Amid Heavy Fighting
war_summary: On day 248 the war remains undecided, yet the past three hours have sharpened the picture of the most volatile sectors. Weathered Expanse still leads the slaughter, adding roughly 9,600 Colonial and 12,900 Warden casualties in the last 24 hours and recording thirty‑three base transitions, the latest logged at the wire. Godcrofts continues its relentless churn with sixty‑two flips, though losses there stay modest. Fishermans Row has erupted, posting thirty‑five ownership changes — the newest at 23:55 — and a sharp rise in both sides’ dead. Stlican Shelf follows with thirty‑one flips, the most recent registered just now, and near‑equal casualties for each faction. Linn Mercy and Mooring County each logged ten and nine flips respectively, with Linn Mercy showing a pronounced Warden loss spike. DeadLands, Farranac Coast, and Callahans Passage have gone quiet in the last two hours after earlier bursts. Enlistments climb sharply on the active fronts, especially Weathered Expanse (+58) and Linn Mercy (+66), while the majority of regions report no base movement. The strategic map therefore hinges on the six sectors above for any near‑term ownership swings.
